name: Over Engineered
summary:
Over Engineered is simulation strategy game that encourages construction of complex machines.
Using limited space, money, and power; you must build complex contraptions to bring a ball from its spawn, to its goal. The longer each ball takes, the more money you make in return.
Play through dozens of Rube Goldberg style puzzles, each carefully crafted to challenge your engineering intuition. With a fixed set of parts, and a locked goal; you must think critically to understand how each component interacts with each other.
